selection_rule: Candidates are ranked for a controlled independent conformance study only. No provider becomes a production dependency until it passes official known-answer, validity-envelope, phase/domain, units, safety and reproducibility gates.

api.two_phase_policy: Transport functions are per-phase and refuse a two-phase state rather than silently averaging; saturation tables expose phase-specific values.

additional_tests_reported: PH and PS inverse round trips
region-series arithmetic compared with a powi reference implementation
Region 3 density solver comparison with earlier scan/Brent path

upstream_release_ci.scope: Upstream project CI at the release commit. It is not a Symtropy adapter test or independent qualification.

integration_risks: API pressure is kPa absolute while Symtropy contracts store SI pressure in Pa; adapter must use explicit checked Pa↔kPa conversion.
Library is explicitly water/steam only; no saline-brine equation-of-state support is claimed.
Region 3 state handling and near-critical phase classification require independent boundary tests.
Single-maintainer / limited-adoption context is a supply-chain and long-term maintenance consideration, not evidence of incorrect physics.
Published registry version must be verified against the exact source tag and packaged source before production dependency pinning.

api.region_selector: Rust API exposes an optional region selector for faster calculation.

upstream_claims: 5–20x faster than naive powi-loop implementations for Regions 1–3
3–7x faster than CoolProp IF97 in the package's comparison
integration_risks: Check the exact API units and region-selector behavior.
Inspect release source, unsafe/FFI surface, optional features, native build requirements and licence files.
Performance claims require equal property bundles, same hardware, warm-up, pinned compiler and repeated p50/p95 measurements.
Unit adapter differs from Symtropy SI: pressure Pa→MPa and temperature K→°C require checked conversions; never reuse vle-steam's kPa/K adapter.
Upstream manifest includes native/FFI options and target-cpu=native in its own release profile; review downstream portability and benchmark build flags.
candidates.upstream_ci_evidence: No equivalent exact release CI job was inspected in this reconnaissance; do not infer CI status from docs.rs build status.

integration_risks: Different formulation and possibly different valid range/API; compare physical states and documented tolerances rather than expecting bitwise equality.
License, source maintenance, API units and numerical stability remain to be audited before any dependency decision.

adapter_requirements: SI-only input boundary in Symtropy; explicitly convert Pa to kPa for vle-steam and verify round-trip conversion.
Never infer phase from an unqualified region number alone; preserve saturation/two-phase state and quality.
Require composition identity and refuse any declared saline brine in the IF97 adapter.
Bind every output to exact (fluid, composition, p, T or other input pair, phase, formulation, release, provider commit and boundary).
Run the 19 official known-answer points and independent cross-provider checks; distinguish reference precision from provider-to-provider agreement.
Add region-edge, saturation, critical-neighborhood, out-of-domain, NaN/Inf, unit-confusion, and inverse-state tests.
Record property-output digest and full provider metadata in ReservoirWellheadCase.
Benchmark correctness first; only then compare throughput, p50/p95 latency, allocations and memory.
